user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Wizard Tower Summit. The top of a wizard's tower at night: a stone platform with a glowing arcane orb on a pedestal, a brass telescope aimed at swirling storm clouds, floating spellbooks orbiting slowly, a rune circle etched in light, potion crates, a perched raven, banners snapping in the wind, and periodic lightning illuminating distant crags. Style: arcane fantasy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
